name: Sanctuary Lights and Gremlin Hands
summary:
AN UNUSUAL WINTER STORM STRIKES AN UNPREPARED FAIRBROOKS — roads buried, power cut, much of the city without reliable heat or light. The Found Family answers by turning its trades outward. EVIE BECOMES THE ELECTRICAL HEART OF THE RESPONSE — already certified, finally visible; Harley works as a medic in the dark; and the rest build a web of warmth, shelter, transport, repairs, food and community care. The city learns what SANCTUARY DRIVE means beyond an address.

AND BRYN ADOPTS EXACTLY TWO WOMEN IN THE WHOLE ARC: LUMINA AND ABBI. Her quietest arc for intake, one of the loudest to live through.
